values.value: Due by Propose, which is the EARLIEST of the two stages CLOSEPLAN is resident at (Propose and Commit) - a qualifier asked at Propose is already being asked when the deal reaches Propose, whatever else asks it later. Speaker requirement is Any because Matthew ruled internal-team statements ARE evidence: the seller saying "I will turn that into a shared close plan" is the act the question asks about.
